mapper.select: SELECT version FROM schedule_boards WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId}

INSERT INTO schedule_boards (space_id, event_id, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{spaceId}, #{eventId}, 1, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (space_id, event_id) DO UPDATE SET version = schedule_boards.version + 1, updated_at = excluded.updated_at RETURNING version

SELECT si.id AS item_id, si.day, to_char(si.start_time, 'HH24:MI') AS start_time, to_char(si.end_time, 'HH24:MI') AS end_time, si.title, si.place, si.description, si.category, si.audience::text AS audience, si.slot_id, si.sort_order, si.version, si.updated_at, u.display_name AS updated_by_display_name FROM schedule_items si JOIN users u ON u.id = si.updated_by WHERE si.space_id = #{spaceId} AND si.event_id = #{eventId} AND si.id = #{itemId} ORDER BY si.day, si.start_time, si.sort_order, si.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_items ( id, space_id, event_id, day, start_time, end_time, title, place, description, category, audience, slot_id, sort_order, version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{day}, CAST(#{startTime} AS time), CAST(#{endTime} AS time), #{title}, #{place}, #{description}, #{category}, CAST(#{audience} AS jsonb), #{slotId}, #{sortOrder}, 1, #{actorUserId}, #{at}, #{actorUserId}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_items SET day = #{day}, start_time = CAST(#{startTime} AS time), end_time = CAST(#{endTime} AS time), title = #{title}, place = #{place}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, audience = CAST(#{audience} AS jsonb), slot_id = #{slotId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{itemId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM schedule_items WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT sp.id AS publication_id, sp.board_version, sp.snapshot::text AS snapshot, sp.published_at, u.display_name AS published_by_display_name FROM schedule_publications sp JOIN users u ON u.id = sp.published_by WHERE sp.space_id = #{spaceId} AND sp.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY sp.seq DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule_publications ( id, space_id, event_id, board_version, snapshot, changes, published_by, published_at) VALUES ( #{publicationId}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{boardVersion}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb), CAST(#{changes} AS jsonb), #{actorUserId}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS event_id, e.start_date, e.end_date, latest.published_at, latest.snapshot FROM events e LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sp.published_at, sp.snapshot::text AS snapshot FROM schedule_publications sp WHERE sp.space_id = e.space_id AND sp.event_id = e.id ORDER BY sp.seq DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.id = #{eventId}
